rules.message: Each sort key is a row carrying data-hc-sort-key — the ORDER of the rows is the order of the keys.

The list must be reorderable: data-hc-sortable on the container (installSortable) plus a data-hc-sortable-handle in every row — dragging is not the only interface, the handle is also the keyboard one.
Every row needs a data-hc-sortable-handle button — it is the keyboard interface (Space grabs, arrows move).
Name each direction control after its key (dir-<key>), so a no-JS submit carries the keys IN ORDER — one shared name would lose which direction belongs to which key.
Sorting is idempotent navigation — the panel GETs the list URL (data-hx-get), never posts.
The sorted page replaces the grid — declare data-hx-target on the form.
data-hx-target must resolve to the grid element the server re-renders.
Keep action + method="get" on the panel form so Apply works without JavaScript.

Keep header clicks working: a hidden input[data-hc-datagrid-sort] receives the wire and the grid requests on hc:datagridsort (data-hx-trigger) including it — without the pair a header click cycles aria-sort but never sorts.
Include the filter form (data-hx-include) so applying a sort keeps the conditions — a sort that silently drops the filters answers a different question.
